audit.whatIsWrong: The page says Alpha Strike 'dodges your spin' but never states that it makes him untargetable, and never says that Highlander makes him immune to slows.
audit.why: Untargetable is the reason Demacian Justice can be thrown away entirely — the execute fizzles, not just the spin. And Decisive Strike's slow does nothing at all while Highlander is up, so the Q is only worth pressing for the silence in that window. Basic attacks also reduce Alpha Strike's cooldown, so the 20s figure shrinks the longer he is hitting something.
audit.corrected: Wrote the untargetability into wants.foe[1] and spikes[0], the slow immunity into the new spikes[3].

edits.after: Highlander is 85s and makes him immune to slows, so your Q slow is dead weight — press it for the silence, and only where your team's CC can follow.
